disclaimer: Regions denote computational roles inspired by neuroscience naming in REE. Coverage reflects claims, substrate code, and experiment evidence -- not biological completeness or anatomical accuracy. The three planes are orthogonal slices of one co-registered MNI152 template volume, arranged as an orthographic projection sheet: coronal (front, y=-18) above axial (top, z=+6) sharing the left-right axis, sagittal (side, x=0) beside coronal sharing the superior-inferior axis -- so a region lines up across views and can be traced. Each region is placed once in MNI space and projected into every plane it appears in. Region placement follows the founder layout intent (E1=cerebrum, E2=cerebellum, E3=BG commitment) documented in founder_ontology.md and is still being refined.

regions.notes: Three-gate candidacy; beta propagation; action-chunk cache (SD-045 dorsolateral loop). Not a named BG package.

claims_sample.title: Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
claims_sample.subject: selection.basal_ganglia_selector_constitution

claims_sample.title: Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.
claims_sample.subject: selection.unified_dopamine_substrate_learned_gating

claims_sample.title: D1/D2 striatal population split with asymmetric dopamine gain: the Go (direct/D1) and No-Go (indirect/D2) pathways should be represented as TWO populations with OPPOSITE dopamine sensitivity (DA potentiates D1/Go via LTP, depresses D2/No-Go via LTD), NOT collapsed into one additive scoring scalar. REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.
claims_sample.subject: selection.d1_d2_population_split_asymmetric_da_gain

claims_sample.title: Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
claims_sample.subject: selection.parallel_segregated_loops

claims_sample.title: Basal ganglia perform dopaminergic gain/threshold setting on hippocampal attractor dynamics.
claims_sample.subject: basal_ganglia.dopaminergic_attractor_threshold_setting

claims_sample.title: Staggered ventral->dorsal commitment-loop calibration windows: the three commitment loops do not share a single critical period. Their calibration windows are staggered ventral->dorsal -- the limbic/value loop (ventral striatum / OFC) opens earliest and is the most environmentally sensitive, the associative loop next, the sensorimotor loop last -- with region-specific consolidation latencies (a calibration can be induced during a window but only expressed after it closes).
claims_sample.subject: basal_ganglia.staggered_commitment_loop_calibration_windows

claims_sample.title: F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.
claims_sample.subject: selection.primary_score_variance_monopoly

claims_sample.title: Committed-action diversity survives the selection/commit step via a behavioral-descriptor eligible-set ARCHIVE (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites analog): the committed E3 selection should draw from a structure that, UPSTREAM of the winner-take-all commit, partitions the eligible candidate set by a behavioral descriptor (first-action / committed-action class / e2.world_forward strategy signature, NOT F-rank) and retains the F-best candidate WITHIN each behavioral niche, then commits by a coverage-aware rule -- so a behaviorally-distinct action stays selectable at a moderate primary-score (F) gap, bounded by the per-niche-elite safety envelope, rather than collapsing to F's single global optimum. The validated V3-EXQ-569i top-k shortlist is the descriptor-free degenerate instance (eligible-set axis = F-rank, near-ties only); MAP-Elites generalizes it to a behavioral-descriptor-indexed eligible-set archive paired with an active variability generator (MECH-313), predicted to convert per-candidate diversity into committed-action diversity more robustly than the thin near-tie shortlist. The F-dominated committed argmax itself (MECH-439) is biologically faithful and is NOT changed -- only the eligible-set structure feeding it.
claims_sample.subject: selection.behavioral_descriptor_committed_selection_archive

claims_sample.title: Conflict-graded near-tie lever sufficiency: a hyperdirect-STN-like conflict-graded shortlist / commit-temperature lever (k = f(top-F gap); T = f(top-F gap)) is SUFFICIENT to lift committed-action-class entropy strict-above both collapsed-proposer and gap-blind controls -- gap-CONCENTRATED (the lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) -- WITHOUT reducing F's E3 variance share. I.e. F can keep monopolising selection variance and conversion is still recovered by widening/hotting only at near-ties.
claims_sample.subject: selection.conflict_graded_near_tie_sufficiency

claims_sample.title: Residual conversion ceiling requiring rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion: near-tie levers (conflict-graded shortlist / commit-T, MECH-447) CAP committed-action-class entropy BELOW the proposer ceiling because they act only at near-ties while F still decides every non-tie; only REMOVING F from the final committed argmin -- demoting it to a graded ELIGIBILITY envelope (rank-preserving renormalisation against the competing field; divisive-normalisation analog) so a modulatory/diversity channel arbitrates within the F-eligible set -- lifts committed diversity to the proposer ceiling without disinhibiting harmful classes.
claims_sample.subject: selection.rank_preserving_f_to_eligibility_demotion

Competent action learning in REE requires a DEDICATED RPE-driven actor-critic policy-learning substrate (a dorsal-striatal analog: a parameterized actor trained on a reward-error teaching signal, with a value-baseline critic), architecturally distinct from -- and NOT reducible to -- the current thin bias_head REINFORCE readout over the prediction-trained (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive) encoder. 'Prediction-rich, action-poor': REE trains a substantial world model but has no dedicated action-learning system -- in brains, action learning IS a substantial learning system (O'Doherty 2004 dorsal-striatum-as-actor; Schultz 1997 dopaminergic RPE teacher), not a bias term on a prediction model.

claims_sample.title: return_scale_invariance_blocks_actor_bootstrap / one_sided_return_normalisation. REE's MECH-457 actor-critic update stacks TWO two-sided normalisers -- a Welford RUNNING reward std (r / running_std) followed by a per-episode advantage standardisation ((adv - mean) / (std + 1e-8)) -- which together form a SCALE-INVARIANCE OPERATOR: after it the policy gradient depends only on the SHAPE of the within-episode advantage vector and is exactly invariant to any multiplicative rescaling. This is sufficient to produce converter invariance to every MAGNITUDE lever by construction (the reward-coupling and drive-schedule axes eliminated by V3-EXQ-771 and 770), and it converts a zero-forage episode -- whose reward stream is harm_signal + novelty_bonus only, so whose advantage vector is pure critic error plus exploration jitter -- into a FULL-MAGNITUDE unit-variance noise gradient. DreamerV3 (Hafner 2023) names this exact failure ('amplification of near-zero returns', Appendix E) and prescribes the corrective: a STATIONARY magnitude compressor (symlog, explicitly against running-statistics normalisation, which injects non-stationarity because the target moves when the normaliser moves), a ONE-SIDED percentile normaliser adv / max(1, Per95 - Per5) that scales large returns down and never scales small returns up, and a DISTRIBUTIONAL twohot/cross-entropy critic in place of a scalar MSE head (which under a bimodal sparse-return distribution converges to the never-observed MEAN of the two modes, and whose gradient is linear in the error rather than bounded).
claims_sample.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.return_pathway_stabilisation

claims_sample.title: transient_behavioral_prior_bootstrap / bc_seed_then_rl_without_permanent_demonstrator. What a behavioural-cloning prior supplies to a floored converter is PRIMARILY TRACTABLE EXPLORATION / STATE-VISITATION, not merely a competent action distribution: VPT (Baker 2022) reports RL from random initialisation in the same action space obtains essentially no reward and never reliably reaches the first link in the item chain, while BC-initialised RL reaches the diamond pickaxe -- a PRESENCE/ABSENCE result, not a speed-up. Three further functions are separable: the action distribution (the vehicle), VALUE-SIDE GROUNDING (DQfD's large-margin loss, which plain BC does NOT supply and whose ablation costs most of the benefit), and STRATEGIC-DIVERSITY PRESERVATION against collapse (AlphaStar). Because REE already owns deterministic in-substrate demonstrators (LocalViewGreedyPolicy 48-55 and OraclePolicy 57-61, instantiated in experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py::run_anchor_cell), NO PERMANENT EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATOR IS REQUIRED -- REE's transience question is not how to stop paying for demonstrations but whether the seed leaves a RESIDUE in the converter after the guide leaves the action path. The only strong transience construct in the literature is JSRL's ROLLOUT HANDOFF (a guide acts for the first h steps, the learner for H-h, with h decreasing to 0 as the learner clears a threshold), NOT a decaying loss weight: none of VPT, AlphaStar or DQfD ever anneals its prior term to zero.

claims_sample.title: innate_action_primitive_basis_plus_reward_independent_engagement_drive. Biological competence bootstrap without a demonstrator rests on TWO components, not one. (i) The action basis is INNATE AND REFINED, never constructed: the two neonatal motoneuron primitives are RETAINED into adulthood and augmented, with matching primitives across rat/cat/macaque/guineafowl (Dominici 2011, 10.1126/science.1210617) -- so 'a learner with no action prior fails' is the biological DEFAULT, not an anomaly; and the innate seed is demonstrator-free but NOT experience-free, since deprived of proprioceptive feedback from its OWN self-generated activity the CPG fails to mature (Zeng 2021). (ii) A REWARD-INDEPENDENT ENGAGEMENT DRIVE is necessary: an identified ZIm circuit converts stimulus presence into investigation independent of learned reward value (Ahmadlou 2021, 10.1126/science.abe9681), and dopamine-deficient mice with INTACT perception, INTACT motor apparatus and INTACT hedonics starve in front of food (Szczypka 2001) -- the closest biological analog of REE's 'readiness met on every leg, foraging at floor'. COROLLARY for REE: an approach primitive is underspecified unless one also names WHAT THE DRIVE'S OUTPUT TRAINS (the Zeng closed loop), because an innate generator alone does not mature.

claims_sample.title: uninformative_value_baseline_makes_optimisation_iatrogenic. In REE's MECH-457 actor-critic pathway the value baseline is UNINFORMATIVE on the policy's own state distribution, so the advantage carries variance rather than signal and ADDED OPTIMISATION PRESSURE IS IATROGENIC: policy capacity, training budget, an earned intrinsic approach drive, environmental reward-coupling and post-installation RL refinement each drive competence BELOW THEIR OWN CONTROLS rather than plateauing beneath a ceiling, and the magnitude of the loss tracks baseline uninformativeness rather than the identity of the intervention. Measured mechanism: V3-EXQ-782 R-(b) reads the shared CTRL critic at std(V)/std(G) = 0.041 against a 0.25 collapse threshold and a pre-reward-vs-far separation ratio of 0.016 against a 0.25 floor -- an unbaselined high-variance advantage. A ceiling plateaus; this does not.

claims_sample.title: policy_hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation (parent commitment for dynamic policy-primitive granularity in hippocampal rollout). Architectural commitment: the unit-of-policy that the rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) and the diversity-generation layer (ARC-065) operate on is itself a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive. The granularity rescales based on simulation outcomes -- decomposed into finer primitives when a chunk fails to ground at execution / prediction resolution (ARC-070), composed into a single primitive when a sequence has been repeatedly grounded with consistent outcomes (ARC-071). Without this commitment, ARC-007 hippocampal proposals are flat action sequences at fixed grain, and the rule layer must apprehend rules at whatever grain the proposer happens to emit, which may be too fine (combinatorial explosion in rollout) or too coarse (chunks fail to map onto the actual state). claims_sample.title: Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

claims_sample.title: stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).
